items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Guards for contrast, 12px floor, motion, 3px ring, status text and 44px targets exist and run; Agents window is a full-screen list->detail sheet with Back and 56px rows; phone table/result/sheet/viewer-wrap behaviours asserted in a Pixel 5 spec; follow-ups (a) and (c) done, (b) deliberately kept (pinned by FR-01.38 e2e).

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Back is hidden with no agents; the selected agent falling away still resolves to the first agent; focus moves only to a visible target; the contrast test throws when a token is renamed so it cannot pass silently.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Client-only CSS/state change: no new route, fetch, HTML injection, JSONL write or chat surface.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 57 contrast rungs + 47 style guards over the parsed stylesheets (proved to bite: they found 9 sub-12px sizes, 3 ungated motions, 2 contrast pairs, 1 removed focus ring), component test for drill-down + status pills, real-browser phone spec.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: One boolean of state and CSS only; no timers, observers or polling added; the findAgentHandback filter is a constant-time check inside the existing loop.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: AgentsWindow 101 lines, agentsTree 89, new mission-a11y.css 10 lines; no file crosses 300; MissionBody and narrator-transcript untouched.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: No serialized format changed; the only producer/consumer seam touched is handback origin (parser sets it, findAgentHandback now requires subagent) - probed by the real-JSONL V2/M4 e2e specs and a new negative unit case.
